12445.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
12445.overview: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.
12445.original_title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2

50013.title: Wings
50013.overview: Former fighter pilot turned provincial schoolmistress Nadezhda Petrovna struggles to adapt to peacetime, having internalised military ideals of service and obedience.

73245.title: Bleach the Movie: Hell Verse
73245.overview: Hell – A place where beings that have committed mortal sins during their lifetime are sent. It is a realm where even Soul Reapers are forbidden to interfere. When a group of vicious Sinners plot to escape from this eternal prison, they discover that Substitute Soul Reaper Ichigo Kurosaki is the key to their freedom.
73245.trailerName: BLEACH THE MOVIE 4: HELL VERSE Official Trailer - Available March 2013
73245.original_title: 劇場版 BLEACH 地獄篇

394269.title: Lemonade
394269.overview: The second "visual album" (a collection of short films) by Beyoncé, this time around she takes a piercing look at racial issues and feminist concepts through a sexualized, satirical, and solemn tone.

587357.title: Miss Moxy
587357.overview: From the cobbled streets of Paris to the wild countryside of Europe, follow Miss Moxy — a pampered cat with a whole lot of cattitude — as she’s thrown into the adventure of a lifetime. Lost far from home, she must team up with a goofy dog and a wise old bird to find her way back… and discover who she truly is along the way.

725149.title: Grateful Dead: Giants Stadium 1991
725149.overview: The Grateful Dead’s complete concert from June 17, 1991 at Giants Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. The show is one of only two recorded on 48-track analog tape, providing spectacular and unprecedented audio quality. The 1991 Giants Stadium show features fan favorites such as "Eyes Of The World,""Truckin’,""Uncle John’s Band," along with Grateful Dead rarities including "Saint Of Circumstance," "Might As Well," "New Speedway Boogie," and so much more.
725149.trailerName: Grateful Dead – 2026 Meet-Up At The Movies – Giants Stadium 6/17/91 | Official Trailer

737885.title: Nightmare Hospital
737885.overview: A horror film about a pilot who is the sole survivor of the plane crash in the deep unknown. He must survive in an isolated building where something evil is waiting.

811677.title: Serious Case Innocence
811677.overview: This film tells the story of Zhang Chenfeng, the head of the Major Crimes Unit, who is framed as a murderer by Yu Jianming. After Zhang Chenfeng is arrested, with the help of criminal investigation expert Zhou Yang and other members of the Major Crimes Unit, the real serial killer is successfully brought to justice.

838301.title: Memory
838301.overview: After her parents’ divorce, six-year-old Vladlena moves from Crimea to Grozny, not yet aware of the changes that lie ahead. When war breaks out in Chechnya, it deeply affects her city and family. Years later, filmmaker Sandu reflects on her childhood in this poetic, autobiographical hybrid film, exploring how cycles of violence shape children—and how healing and change are possible.

841309.title: Scars of Revenge
841309.overview: One has no memory, the other cannot forget.

1020829.title: Wild Foxes
1020829.overview: At a sports boarding school, talented young boxer Camille narrowly survives a fatal accident, saved by his best friend Matteo. After a swift recovery, an inexplicable pain gradually takes hold of him, threatening his dreams of greatness and his relationship with the team. In the ring and in a man's world, there’s no room for weakness.

1054493.title: Pennum Porattum
1054493.overview: When a woman and her dog face public hostility, a village's hidden tensions erupt. A stark examination of mob mentality, social judgment, and how communities can turn cruel when seeking to punish perceived wrongs.

1109469.title: Beach Read
1109469.overview: When an idealistic romance novelist and a cynical literary fiction writer—rival authors with dramatically opposing worldviews and a serious case of writer's block—unexpectedly find themselves living next door to each other in a small Lake Michigan beach town for the summer, they strike an unlikely bet to swap genres and the lines between fiction and romance begin to blur.

1137245.title: Three Friends
1137245.overview: Joan is no longer in love with Victor, but it pains her to feel she is being dishonest with him. Alice, her best friend, reassures her: She herself doesn’t feel passionate about her partner Eric and yet their relationship is smooth sailing. She has no idea he is having an affair with Rebecca, their mutual friend. When Joan finally decides to leave Victor and he disappears, the lives of the three friends and their relationships are turned upside down.

1153885.title: Missing*Link
1153885.overview: Mia, 12, is spending her vacation at a lake in the Black Forest with her parents, who have been separated for years, and their new partners. While the adults try to keep things light, Mia escapes more and more often into the forest, where she meets a mysterious boy. On the morning of her birthday, Mia disappears. The fragile family structure is turned upside down and Mia's new freedom becomes increasingly dangerous.

1158941.title: Green Concrete
1158941.overview: Should the trees in the city always disappear whenever reconstruction takes place? The project, which began with memories and records, leads to meeting various people from different fields to explore practical ways to preserve trees. The film follows the whereabouts of the trees that once lived on a green island in a ruin of concrete until they eventually vanished.

1184925.title: Midnight Oxygen
1184925.overview: Described as an ensemble, coming of age extraterrestrial horror movie.

1193501.title: Whistle
1193501.overview: A misfit group of unwitting high school students stumble upon a cursed object, an ancient Aztec Death Whistle. They discover that blowing the whistle and the terrifying sound it emits will summon their future deaths to hunt them down.

1202205.title: L'Hiver d'Edmond et Lucy
1202205.overview: Edmond, the squirrel, and Lucy, the young bear, live together in a majestic chestnut tree in the heart of the forest. When winter comes, they get ready to confront it... Between snowball fights and treasure hunts, they are going to have lots to do.

1224541.title: Vira-Lata
1224541.overview: Odete and her daughters face financial difficulties after the death of her husband, Suelen, the middle daughter, cannot fit into the new routine, Sara, the youngest daughter, believes that the world is going to end.

1241693.title: Do Deewane Seher Mein
1241693.overview: Two socially awkward millennials in Mumbai find love while struggling with self-acceptance. As they battle insecurities and societal pressure, their journey takes them from city chaos to mountain serenity.

1243741.title: Ballistic
1243741.overview: When a soldier's mother discovers the bullet that killed her son in Afghanistan was made at the factory where she works, she sets out on a path of revenge against those responsible.

1273629.title: Queen of France
1273629.overview: 11th century Russia. Grand Prince Yaroslav the Wise betroths his favorite daughter Anne to Henry I, King of the Franks, and sends her across Europe to her future husband. Warrior Ostromir, former mercenary who previously served the Byzantine Emperor, is charged with guarding the princess on a long dangerous journey. Along the way, Anne and Ostromir fall in love with one another.

1278365.title: Alfredo Corrado
1278365.overview: Julien Bourges partly retraces the life of Alfredo Corrado, an American deaf artist. Today, considered an important figure in the French deaf community, Alfredo Corrrado came to Paris in the late 1970s, at a time when sign language was forbidden and scorned. This unique documentary on Alfredo Corrado recounts the creation of International Visual Theater (IVT) and the adventures of the first deaf theater in France at the Château de Vincennes, which changed the history of deaf people in France.

1297245.title: A Man and A Woman
1297245.overview: In the early spring of 2021, a man and a woman flew to Hong Kong at the same time, and while waiting to enter the mainland, they stayed in the same hotel, separated by a wall. During the short intersection of their lives, the two confided in each other about the pressure they were burdened with and found a spiritual harbor in Hong Kong, where tenacious vitality was blooming. And before the answer is revealed, the choice stops abruptly.

1309725.title: The Richest Woman in the World
1309725.overview: An elderly billionaire woman gives hundreds of millions of euros to a younger gay artist she is close to. Her daughter files a complaint for abuse of a vulnerable person and a scandal erupts.
1309725.trailerName: The Richest Woman in the World - Trailer
1309725.original_title: La Femme la plus riche du monde

1318621.title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
1318621.overview: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain — Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

1341341.title: 4 Kids Walk Into a Bank
1341341.overview: After losing her mother, Paige's grandfather steps into to become a more responsible guardian. But when a group of criminals show up at their door demanding that Paige's grandpa join them for one last job, she's faced with a decision: let her newly reformed grandpa dip back into his criminal ways, or enlist her three best friends to do the job first.

1359005.title: Per Aspera Ad Astra
1359005.overview: Set in the near future, the story revolves around the emergence of the virtual dream reality technology "Good Dreams",  which allows people to do whatever they desire within their self-created dreams. However, a crisis triggered by these dreams quietly unfolds.
1359005.trailerName: [ENG SUB] Per Aspera Ad Astra 星河入梦 (2026) "Dream Crisis" Trailer | Dylan Wang 王鹤棣 Wang Hedi

1373789.title: Not All Men
1373789.overview: After breaking free from a long, toxic relationship, Fernanda embarks on a weekend getaway with three friends, seeking solace and distraction. However, what begins as an escape quickly devolves into a whirlwind of tension and hidden agendas, as the group's true intentions come to light, forcing Fernanda to confront the reality she sought to escape.

1389149.title: Accused
1389149.overview: When a celebrated queer doctor in London is accused of sexual misconduct, her life unravels. Now under a storm of suspicion and scrutiny, her marriage fractures and the truth blurs. Her wife must decide whether to walk away, or fight for the woman the world is turning against.

1401757.title: Antarctic
1401757.overview: A brutal crime shocks an isolated Brazilian research station in Antarctica, transforming the enviroment filled with scientists and military personnel into a veritable pressure cooker. The men at the station become suspects, and a female deputy commander takes on the mission of investigating what happened and, with the support of the women at the base, faces silence and violence in her search for justice.

1418397.title: Anchorless
1418397.overview: During a trip to Brazil in 2022, Augusto (15), an introspective and dreamy young man, becomes enchanted by Antônio (16), a magnetic and unpredictable boy from Belém. Amid the heat of the World Cup and the waters reflecting a fleeting encounter, a fragile connection is born, stretching across distance when Augusto returns to Italy, turning desire into obsession. While Augusto loses himself in idealizations and the emptiness of delayed responses, Antônio continues his life between parties, friends, and fleeting loves. What begins as a promising romance crumbles under the weight of time, silence, and the things that were never said. As the years pass, Augusto is forced to face an inevitable truth: some loves do not belong to the future, they exist only in memory. An intimate and visceral portrait of love, loss, and growth, Anchorless delves into the fragility of first feelings and the pain of learning that not every story is destined to last.
1418397.trailerName: "ANCHORLESS" (2025) ANNOUCEMENT TEASER TRAILER | GRAN MAKER STUDIOS

1425373.title: The Golden Spurtle
1425373.overview: In a quaint Scottish village in the Highlands, contenders from around the globe gather to compete for the title of World Porridge Champion armed only with oats, salt and water. As the ailing Porridge Chieftain's tenure ends, he embarks on a mission to find a successor. Amidst intense rivalries and the charm of eccentric locals, this documentary delves into the legacy of the village and unveils a captivating culinary spectacle.

1428893.title: One Last Deal
1428893.overview: Jimmy Banks is an old school agent who desperately needs to get his star player one last big payday before Jimmy’s life, and his client’s reputation, comes tumbling down.

1433117.title: Kara
1433117.overview: A thief tries to go straight, but when predatory banks trap his father in debt, he returns to crime — with a determined cop closing in on his trail.

1436061.title: Fabian and the Deadly Wedding
1436061.overview: Hapless con artist Fabian crashes a quirky winter wedding, planning to steal a valuable gift meant for the bride. But when a murder disrupts his scheme, Fabian finds himself unexpectedly drawn into solving the mystery. A thrilling murder mystery comedy packed with dark secrets.

1437981.title: Coward
1437981.overview: Pierre, a young Belgian soldier, wants to prove himself on the battlefield during the First World War. Behind the frontlines, he meets Francis, who is asked to find a way to boost morale.

1444061.title: Island of Hope
1444061.overview: A coming-of-age story of a highly sensitive hyperactive city dweller Nadja (24) living on the edge of social exclusion, deepest fears, the world of self-help and the encounter of a strange intergenerational burden. The observational documentary was filmed during a period of six years.

1446301.title: Yo no moriré de amor
1446301.overview: At 18, Claudia doesn't want to be a hero. Her mother's illness erupts like a silent storm, forcing a redefinition of roles in a family long estranged. Torn between the duty to care for her mother and the desire to live like any other girl her age, Claudia searches for a way to navigate this new reality, which will transform the bonds between the entire family.

1451229.title: Congé
1451229.overview: On a rare day off, a mother and her son make the most of their time together, until an unexpected call turns everything upside down.

1455389.title: Cosmic Trace
1455389.overview: Hyeonji, an assistant producer for a YouTube channel, and Jihyeon , a struggling actor, continue living together while grappling with anxieties about the present and the future. When Hyeonji's father dies suddenly and Jihyeon's mother is diagnosed with terminal cancer, they find themselves overwhelmed.

1469469.title: Smudge the Blades
1469469.overview: Treaty 6 Blades, an under-18 hockey team from an Alberta reservation, face their last season together while navigating their tough northern league.

1472669.title: The End
1472669.overview: A story about death at an airport

1483101.title: Dovzhenko. First Sight
1483101.overview: Ukrainian Odesa, 1926: a city recovering from the war, a city where jazz sounds and cinema is born. Young artist Sashko Dovzhenko seeks freedom in art - and stumbles upon a system that does not forgive dreams. His first film may be his last. And he does not yet know that soon his name will be known to the whole world.

1490653.title: pages.
1490653.overview: At a quiet city bus stop, a forgotten book becomes the silent witness to the passing moments, choices, and connections of those who come and go.

1493021.title: Lavoreremo da grandi
1493021.overview: Three friends, Beppe, Umberto, and Gigi, await the arrival of young Toni to celebrate his newfound freedom. After an evening of heavy drinking at the village bar, the car they're about to drive home in hits something. Or rather, someone. Setting off a series of relentless bad decisions, the four flee and take refuge at Umberto's house. It will be a long night of plot twists, paradoxical and ridiculous situations, encounters and clashes between the protagonists and other improbable figures who populate that interminable day. Until the most unimaginable of solutions arrives at first light.

1502173.title: Jönssonligan & Wall Enberg
1502173.overview: After being deceived by Wall Enberg, the Jönsson Gang decides to strike back with their most daring heist yet: to snatch Walls beloved artwork 'Pluto's Throne'—worth 400 million kronor, locked away in his private Franz Jäger vault. To succeed, they must outsmart a vain police chief, a desperate small-time gangster known as the 'The Shrimp', and Wall Enberg himself—who will stop at nothing to get his revenge.

1506653.title: Dora
1506653.overview: A family retreats to the seaside, far from the bustle of Seoul. Their daughter, Dora, suffers from a mysterious illness. Her discovery of love unleashes a force as powerful as it is dangerous, with far-reaching consequences for those around her…

1508701.title: God Forgives Everyone
1508701.overview: Arturo is a lonely, gluttonous, and disillusioned Sicilian real estate agent. His mundane life finally finds its spark through his one true passion: Sicilian pastries. It’s over a tray of cannoli that he meets his soulmate, Flora. She is everything he ever dreamed of—beautiful, witty, and brilliant. To top it off, she’s a pastry chef.  However, a divine obstacle stands between them: God.  While Flora is a devout, fervent Catholic, Arturo abandoned his faith as a child. Desperate not to lose the woman of his dreams, he decides to "fake it 'til he makes it," pretending to be a man of deep conviction. Guiding Arturo on this chaotic journey toward truth, faith, and Flora’s heart is an unlikely mentor and friend: Pope Francis himself.

1514333.title: Wild Wild East
1514333.overview: In occupied Poland 1943, German official Martin Wolff is sent to a remote village to investigate the disappearance of a Jewish lawyer. His arrival unsettles the fragile order between scarred villagers, corrupt collaborators, and Nazi authorities, unearthing a web of betrayal and greed tied to whispers of the lawyer’s hidden fortune. Yet as the village’s darkest truths come to light, Wolff’s search may be hiding more than it reveals.

1520093.title: God of Mischief
1520093.overview: When a cheeky 10-year-old boy sets his sights on playing Loki in the school play, his over-the-top confidence costs him the role, but he hatches a mischievous plan to prove he's the real god of mischief after all.
1520093.trailerName: GOD OF MISCHIEF | Official Trailer | Not Thought Through (2026)

1522333.title: Carry On Jatta 4
1522333.overview: A romantic deception spirals into household chaos when a family must construct an elaborate web of lies to conceal a secret relationship.
1522333.trailerName: Carry On Jatta 4 (Trailer) Gippy Grewal | Binnu Dhillon | Sargun Mehta | Late Jaswinder Bhalla Ji

1539421.title: The Metamorphosis
1539421.overview: When Gregório, a modest sales representative, mysteriously transforms into an insect, his social relationships and ties to the world begin to disintegrate. Tormented by incessant thoughts, he struggles to feel and remain human.

1542877.title: Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time
1542877.overview: United by a common mission to eliminate their teacher, Koro-sensei, an alien creature with phenomenal strength, join Nagisa and his Class 3-E classmates in brand-new adventures.
1542877.original_title: 劇場版「暗殺教室」みんなの時間

1549725.title: The Forest
1549725.overview: A story about primeval forests - a world of subtle connections that have been formed for thousands of years. Cedars, spruces, firs grow here, and on the European continent, such forests have survived only in the north of Russia.

1553373.title: Chum
1553373.overview: Randy and Filthy are two lowlife roadies who land a new gig and hit the streets on foot, crossing paths with a bizarre cast of characters. Along the way, they're gifted a strange, powerful fish-while being relentlessly stalked by their old rival, Texas.

1557981.title: When Will You Get Divorced?
1557981.overview: A bride and her new sister-in-law get mixed up in the world of international jewel theft and espionage after the groom vanishes from the wedding.

1571101.title: Evolution
1571101.overview: When an alien substance mixes Zoe’s DNA with that of her exotic pets, a hilarious adventure begins where humans turn into animals, animals turn into humans, and everyone must come to an agreement to save the world.

1588765.title: Brandon & Haider
1588765.overview: When the enigmatic allure of two ancient artifacts is unleashed, two students are bestowed with unparalleled powers. Yet, a relentless collector, driven by an insatiable thirst for dominion, will stop at nothing to seize them, igniting a cataclysmic battle that will determine the fate of worlds

1590173.title: Love Yourself Tender
1590173.overview: Nadua is a successful otolaryngologist-surgeon, but by the age of 40 she suddenly realized that she didn't know anything about herself at all. Every day at work, she examines the sensory organs of patients, but she has forgotten how to hear her own feelings, or maybe she has never heard them. Her husband Boris left her two years ago, unable to stand the routine, although the couple is still not divorced. Nadya brings up her daughter Oliviya and continues to live in her mother-in-law's apartment. Nadya needs changes to see that there really is a lot of love in the world. And in her life there are six "lessons of tenderness", each of which will help her to find herself again, her own voice and her new hope.

1601885.title: Light Pillar
1601885.overview: The future. Winter. Space travel is no longer a dream. A lonely janitor tends the grounds of a dilapidated bankrupt film studio with only a former cat actor for company until he embarks on a romantic journey with a female player in a beautiful virtual world.

1602653.title: A Grand Biltmore Christmas
1602653.overview: In 1895, Elizabeth meets Michael, a teen trespasser at Biltmore House who vanishes. When he returns 20 years later, a magic hourglass pulls her to the present. She must return home before being found and before love alters her destiny.

1616157.title: Shanghai Daughter
1616157.overview: A Shanghai woman journeys alone to a rubber plantation in southwest China, where her late father was sent during the Cultural Revolution. As she searches for a mysterious woman, some strangers unexpectedly drift into her path.

1616861.title: Everything Else Is Noise
1616861.overview: Rosa, a contemporary music composer, agrees to give her first television interview at her colleague Tere’s apartment to keep it secret from her husband. What begins as a simple professional conversation turns into an absurd and comic portrait of rivalries and affections among three women—Rosa, Tere, and Tere’s daughter Luisa—interrupted by power outages, a constantly barking dog, and the visit of a famous composer. As the interview unravels, family and artistic tensions surface, revealing, with humor, both the fragility of prestige and the strength of complicity.

1620829.title: Caterpillar
1620829.overview: Three generations living under one leaky Wellington roof in 2003, all on the brink of transformation. Sixteen-year-old Cassie is all bravado and vulnerability, drifting into risky territory as she searches for validation in all the wrong places. Her mother Maxine, 52, a formidable single-mother filmmaker on the brink of a long-awaited breakthrough, is finally offered a greenlight - if she can just land a star. Holding everything together is Huia, Cassie’s grandmother, 80, whose life has been defined by quiet service to family and a private obsession with raising monarch caterpillars, dreaming of one day witnessing the legendary butterfly migration in Mexico. But when Huia’s mind begins to fail her, the family is thrust into chaos. Can the maternal line hold together while everything is throwing them apart?

1621277.title: Uprooted
1621277.overview: Just as a couple prepares to welcome their long-awaited child, a devoted couple meets a troubled teen whose wounded heart resists faith. Their paths intertwine in a story of love, healing, and unexpected grace.

1622621.title: You, Fireworks, and Our Promise
1622621.overview: The coming-of-age romance is set during the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Show, one of Japan's three major fireworks shows that draws several hundred thousand visitors to Niigata Prefecture every year. What connects Makoto (a Tokyo high school boy without social skills or self-confidence) and Aki (a popular high school girl and class president with beauty and talent) is a drawing of a fireworks display. At the mercy of the drawing's mystery and fate itself, the two have to make a choice in a limited amount of time.

1623517.title: Shocktopus
1623517.overview: An alien amoeba crashes to Earth and mutates aquatic life along the shores of North Carolina, unleashing an electrified octopus that terrorizes a seaside resort. Two special operatives try to stop the shock wave of cosmic carnage.

1629469.title: Sweety Naughty Crazy
1629469.overview: Shiva, a charming college student juggling three different relationships. As he tries to keep them secret, love, lust, and chaos collide in a playful mix of adult humor, romance, and comedy.

1630237.title: Treasure Trekkers
1630237.overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.
1630237.trailerName: Will They Survive the Quest? Treasure Trekkers Official Trailer Drop

1633309.title: Cinco días con Lara
1633309.overview: Lara Martorell is a transgender actress working to make a name for herself in the acting world. On a trip to Asturias, where she lives, we’ll take a look at her present and her past to understand the long journey that has led her to become the Lara she is today.

1634845.title: Todo Mundo no Rio com Shakira
1634845.overview: On the iconic sands of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, Shakira sets Copacabana Beach ablaze in the third edition of “Todo Mundo no Rio”. Before a historic crowd of 2 million people, the Colombian superstar celebrates three decades of hits in an electrifying performance that bridges her new album, “Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran,” with the timeless classics that defined her career. Featuring guest appearances by Brazilian music icons and a high-tech visual spectacle, the night transforms the coastline into the stage for an epic celebration of power, music, and the artist’s unbreakable connection with Brazil.

1636061.title: Al Buio
1636061.overview: Academic short film from Chiara and Nicolò Caggiano, which depicts depression as a long sleep.

1641629.title: You+Me - Against the World
1641629.overview: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

1642333.title: Remnant
1642333.overview: Driving home from the pub, Kevin opportunistically seeks refuge with an eccentric couple after meeting a police checkpoint.

1648413.title: I Wish You Glory
1648413.overview: Mitya, a recent high school student, dreams of fame, but has no idea what price he'll have to pay for it. A random car accident, captured on a cell phone camera, makes him a hostage to a frantic media frenzy. He's caught in the maelstrom of political games and becomes a tool for garnering millions of views for his talk show. However, even this isn't enough for the media. Mitya tries to escape this cycle before he's buried in the news feeds.

1651613.title: Before Me
1651613.overview: A heartbroken photographer falls for an aspiring writer, but after discovering her secret past his retroactive jealousy threatens to ruin everything.

1654365.title: Sweet Rogue Killer
1654365.overview: After destroying the Forelli empire, SRK discovers that the last surviving Forelli bloodline is secretly rebuilding its power through corruption and political influence. As a dangerous conspiracy threatens the township once again, SRK launches a final mission to expose the truth, eliminate the heir, and end the Forelli legacy forever.

1654429.title: Crush The Wicked
1654429.overview: A detective and a vengeful survivor hunt a fugitive serial killer who resurfaces to commit one last desperate crime.

1657821.title: Pauline
1657821.overview: In a bar, Pauline writes to a man she does not know. Between desire, art, and projection, reality eventually begins to crack the story she has invented for herself.

1658653.title: Vanishing Point
1658653.overview: On the morning of the winter solstice, Tang Yu's son disappeared in the stairwell; gambler Yuan Wu hid his father's body; and two unsolved cases involving the assault.

1659229.title: SHAMDEMONIUM
1659229.overview: Young aspiring actress Barb drowns in the pool of a kids birthday party, and must survive in a new thespian purgatory.

1675165.title: Does the horse have to work, too?
1675165.overview: Valeria scouts out available pastures, spins wool, serves as midwife delivering lambs into the world, trims hooves, slaughters, cuddles with sheep, speaks to and watches over them, smoking cigarettes all the while.

1679197.title: Whispers of Nature
1679197.overview: In the mid-1980s, renowned painter Clarke Holler tells a horrifying story from his life on an episode of his painting show "Whispers of Nature"
1679197.trailerName: Whispers of Nature | Official Trailer | Horror Short Film

1680029.title: NJPW Best of the Super Junior 33 - Day 13
1680029.overview: The thirteenth night of Best of the Super Juniors 33 took place on June 5, 2026, at G Messe Gunma in Takasaki, Gunma, Japan, and featured two semifinal matches to determine the tournament finalists.

1683101.title: Ebre / Trarza
1683101.overview: This short documentary addresses the global issue of climate change, highlighting its unequal impacts on rural communities in deltaic regions of both the Global South and North. While the Global North is a major contributor to climate change, its devastating effects are most felt in the Global South, particularly in regions like Trarza, Mauritania, where agriculture is severely impacted. Similarly, the Terres de l’Ebre in Catalonia faces rising sea levels and land erosion, threatening local livelihoods. These shared challenges provide a rich opportunity for youth from both regions to engage in dialogue and storytelling.
1683101.trailerName: Ebre Trarza (WIP - picture lock, color locked, sound post-production in progress)

1684573.title: Masud Rana
1684573.overview: Based on Qazi Anwar Hussain's novel series Masud Rana aka MR-9.

1685725.title: Transept
1685725.overview: Elias Turner is admitted to a psychiatric hospital and is prescribed an experimental medication that is used to treat patients with mental illness, only the prescribed medication isn't what everyone thinks.

1686109.title: Mermaid Mystique 2: Torrential Agony

1686301.title: Mala
1686301.overview: Reema inherits an abandoned resort on a remote island, and with her three friends, sets out to uncover the truth behind her inheritance. 1688861.title: Nostalgia for the Future

Moving through a constellation of personal documents and film fragments, an archivist attempts to decode the man through the material traces he left behind. By repurposing and recontextualizing Marker’s own body of work, the film treats his images as “time machines,” transforming the archive into a landscape of living memory. Nostalgia for the Future is a meditation on memory, identity, and the power our past images hold over the futures we imagine.

1689693.title: Avenca

1690269.trailerName: Faith & Forgiveness: A Duck Dynasty Love Story | Official Trailer (Lifetime, 2026)

It also examines how the destinies of Michael Clegg, chemist Carina Leveriza, and psychedelics advocate Rick Doblin, are inexorably bound with that of the socio-cultural explosion of MDMA through its epic journey of discovery, criminalization, and re-emergence from the shadows.

1737821.title: Outskirts

This structural neglect has contributed to the entrenchment of conditions of decay, poverty, and a lack of opportunities, fostering the rise of power structures alternative to the state, foremost among them the mafia. Through the story of his own experiences in Sicily’s suburbs, the photographer reflects on possible strategies for regenerating these places, highlighting how they still represent spaces capable of preserving a human and relational authenticity that has progressively disappeared from urban centers.

Defiant and unwilling to obey, he somehow keeps finding cargo, calling at ports, loading and unloading, silently roaming the waters of the Pacific.  Day and night, he battles the relentless gales on the lonely voyages of his mind and heart, where the secret he carries has long since dropped anchor.
